title: Close a phase
summary: Ends a delivery phase: every feature done, the demo run, coverage checked, then the owner's signature opens the next phase.

start.github: /sdd status (comment on the phase pull request)

steps.title: Every feature done
steps.does: Each feature in the phase has an approved plan, all tasks ticked, a passing scan, and passing verification and security reports.

steps.title: P1 requirements covered
steps.does: No priority-1 requirement in scope is left without a test.

steps.title: Run the demo
steps.does: Bob drives the demo script in a browser and captures a screenshot per step; the analyst walks the business owner through it.

steps.title: Owner signs the phase
steps.does: Opens the next phase. The pull request then merges (merge commit, not squash) and promote-to-test deploys what passed.
